routes.construct_spec_verbatim: The following cDNAs, cloned into the retroviral PLPCX vector (Clontech Takara Bio Inc., Kusatsu, Japan), were used: full‐length NR4A3; E‐N, corresponding to EWSR1 (exons 1–12)‐NR4A3 (exons 3–8); T‐N, corresponding to TAF15 (exons 1–6)‐NR4A3 (intron 2–exon 8) and T‐N*, corresponding to the commonest TAF15 (exons 1–6)‐NR4A3 (exons 3–8) fusion. Both T‐N and T‐N* encode the whole coding sequence of NR4A3 (exons 3–8); T‐N retains a short cryptic exon located in NR4A3 intron 2 (ENST00000395097.6 isoform), thus encoding 25 additional amino acids prior to the NR4A3 ATG.

prices.⚠_THIS_IS_NOT_tBJ_ER: CRL-2522 is the untransformed parent, not the model. ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.route: R3 — rebuild E-N / T-N* / T-N from the published exon spans
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.why_first: Its critical path contains NO COUNTERPARTY WHO CAN SAY NO OR SAY NOTHING. Synthetic DNA and a catalogue cell line are transactions, not negotiations; the ATCC line ships in 1-3 business days (measured). Every other route's clock is started by someone else replying to an email.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.second_reason: The junction is specified BY CONSTRUCTION, and all three constructs' exon spans are stated verbatim by the authors. Two of the three (EWSR1 e12::NR4A3 e3 and TAF15 e6::NR4A3 e3) match junctions this repository has already screened reagents against at full panel depth; the third (TAF15 e6::NR4A3 intron-2 cryptic exon) has designs but not at panel depth. No resolution step stands between ordering and testing.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.⚠_what_it_does_NOT_buy: A cDNA over-expressed in a heterologous background is not EMC. It can demonstrate junction-selective knockdown of the intended transcript; it cannot show the reagent works in EMC biology, at endogenous expression level, from an endogenous locus. And since tBJ/ER is in no registry, a rebuild would be in a DIFFERENT background from the published one — an isogenic mismatch that has to be declared rather than glossed.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.cost_shape: REAL MONEY: synthetic DNA (price not established) + recipient line ($577.00 ATCC list for CRL-2522, if that is the recipient chosen) + the ASO itself. BENCH TIME: cloning, virus production, transduction, selection, and an RT-qPCR/knockdown readout — none of which is money we can spend, see the binding constraint below.

ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.why_second: It is the only route to a genuinely patient-derived, identity-clean, fusion-positive EMC cell. But its clock starts when a named individual answers, and then runs through a transfer of human-subject-derived material collected under a cantonal ethics approval (BASEC-2021-00417) — the shape of transfer that in practice needs an institutional recipient. Nothing was fetched that establishes the actual terms, so the duration is UNBOUNDED rather than long.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.second_consideration: Even after arrival the cells are slow: doubling times of 5.09 and 6.05 days, passaged every 2-3 weeks as sarco-spheres (PMC9813045). Time-to-first-experiment does not end at delivery.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.third_consideration: The reported acceptor is NR4A3 exon 2 while the screened panel reagents sit at NR4A3 exon 3 — so there is an unresolved matching step between obtaining these cells and choosing a reagent for them.

ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.why_last: Two blockers, and the second one is not about procurement at all. Even granting instant delivery, the line's fusion partner and exons are unknown, so no junction-spanning reagent can be assigned to it — the test article would have to be SEQUENCED before it could be a test article. Ahead of that, the distributing repository's web front end is unreadable (expired certificate) and the line has no registry accession.
ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.not_a_finding_of_absence: None of this says NCC-EMC1-C1 is unavailable. It says the questions are unanswered, and names exactly which fetch would answer each.

ranked_by_time_to_first_experiment.⛔_binding_constraint_on_ALL_THREE: There is no wet lab. research/manuscripts/modality-census/what-a-civilian-can-buy.md records the standing filter F2 verbatim: 'trimcrae does no bench work. A fully contracted service where he ships nothing and does nothing is acceptable; a "kit you run yourself" is not.' Every route above ends at 'someone must culture cells', so the true rate-limiting step for all three is finding a laboratory or a CRO, not finding a cell line or a construct. That ranking is unchanged by any price.
